name: ingot
description: Stores large MCP tool results in Ingot, one table per tool, and hands Claude a short stub to query instead.

url.title: Ingot URL
url.description: The ingot to write into, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3002/api/v1/<account>/<ingot>

api_key.title: Ingot API key
api_key.description: A key for that account; kept in the system keychain
